name: Securities Account Search Criteria 2
definition: Set of search criteria for querying securities account reference data.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the account.

PartyType.name: Party Type
PartyType.definition: Specifies the type of the party for which securities account data have been queried.

OpeningDate.name: Opening Date
OpeningDate.definition: Legal opening date for the securities account.

ClosingDate.name: Closing Date
ClosingDate.definition: Legal closing date for the securities account.

AccountType.name: Account Type
AccountType.definition: Specifies the type of securities account.

EndInvestorFlag.name: End Investor Flag
EndInvestorFlag.definition: Specifies information to identify securities accounts where allocation instructions are posted.

PricingScheme.name: Pricing Scheme
PricingScheme.definition: Defines how the price is applied to the securities account.
